label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.2 a.3…: The wording of the second-mover premise admits the…
locator: I q.2 a.3 co., prima via: moventia secunda non movent nisi per hoc quod sunt mota a primo movente
interpretation: 'Moventia secunda' is unqualified, and the dependence runs to the first mover itself ('a primo movente'), not merely to the next member of a series. This shows the strong reading is textually admissible. It does not exclude the weaker reading, which reads 'per hoc quod sunt mota' as restrictive.
